clearing.onibi:
Clearing cards are used to advance <onibi>the Onibi Pawn</onibi>.
If you advance Onibi to this card, you'll benefit from the bonus action.
clearing.extinguish: You can <extinguish>extinguish the fire</extinguish> by using 2<water/>.
onibi.action: The Onibi pawn moves in the Clearing when the players play the <bold>Advance Onibi</bold> action: <wind/>.
onibi.rule:
When Onibi moves off the clearing, 3 situations are possible:
• <bold>If you have the Onibi card</bold>, place it back in the supply, then continue to advance Onibi starting from the card at the other end of the clearing.
• <bold>If the Onibi card is in the supply</bold>, give it to your opponent, then continue to advance Onibi starting from the card at the other end of the clearing.
• <bold>If your opponent already has the Onibi card</bold>, you fulfill one of the 4 victory conditions and win the game immediately.
end-turn.trigger: The turn ends when both Summer and Winter have used up their 2 action tokens.
end-turn.varan:
Add up the fire value of the clearing cards on fire. A clearing card is on fire if at least Onibi standee or one fire token is on this card.
Next, add up your <water/> values in your personal line, your forest, and those remaining in the help line (i.e., those visible after the final action token placed on the <water/> line).
Both players check to see whether the total value of the clearing cards on fire is strictly higher than their <water/> value. If that’s the case for you, add 1 fire varan card corresponding to your season, as long as there are some left, to the shared discard pile for each clearing card on fire. If not, nothing happens.
end-turn.onibi: Next, check both cards adjacent to the Onibi standee. If there's no fire token on the card yet, place one on it. If the card already contains a fire token, nothing happens. If Onibi is on a card at the edge of the clearing, check the card adjacent to his location, and the card at the other end of the clearing.
onibi.card.rule: If either player draws a card corresponding to your season while you have the Onibi card, <bold>it is placed in the shared help line if it's a guardian animal</bold>, or in front of you if it's a fire varan.
onibi.card.give: You can get rid of the Onibi card or pass it to your opponent by advancing <onibi>the Onibi pawn</onibi>.
sanki.get: There are 3 Sanki cards, which you can retrieve with a bonus action by moving the Onibi counter or planting a tree.
sanki.rule: If a bonus action allows you to retrieve a Sanki card, take it from the supply <bold>or from your opponent if the supply is empty</bold>.
sanki.use:
You can use a Sanki card in 1 of 2 ways:
• To place <bold>1 fire varan card corresponding to your season</bold> back to its pile as soon as it’s revealed.
• To <bold>immediately</bold> use 1 action token after revealing an animal card.
fire.you: You have {number, plural, one{# Fire token} other{# Fire tokens}}.
fire.player: {player} has {number, plural, one{# Fire token} other{# Fire tokens}}.
fire.win: If you have 8 Fire tokens, you win the game.
fire.take: You can <take>take that token</take> by using 2<water/>.
fire.onibi: At the end of each turn, Clearings adjacent to the <onibi>Onibi pawn</onibi> receive a Fire token if they don't already have one.
animal.purpose: The guardian animals will provide you with elements <sun/><water/><plant/><wind/> that will help you to attract other guardian animals, plant protective trees, extinguish fires, and move Onibi through the clearing.
animal.season: This is a {season, select, 1{Summer} 2{Winter} other{Neutral}} Animal.
animal.personal: When an animal from your season is revealed, it is placed in your personal line, except if you have <onibi>the Onibi card</onibi>.
animal.recruit.discard: It will go to the discard pile.
animal.recruit.personal: It will go to your personal line.
animal.solitary: <solitary/>: this animal is <bold>solitary</bold>. When a 3rd solitary animal is placed in the common help line and your personal line, you lose an <action>Action token</action> for this turn. On the 4th, you lose your second Action token.
animal.gregarious: <gregarious/>: this animal is <bold>gregarious</bold>. A gregarious symbol cancels a solitary symbol <solitary/>.
animal.deck:
There {cards, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in the <bold>common draw pile</bold>.
On your turn, you can <draw>draw a card</draw> or play an <action>Action token</action>.
animal.deck.you: There {cards, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in <bold>your guardian animals pile</bold>.
animal.deck.player: There {cards, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in {player}'s guardian animals pile
animal.win:
If you recruit an animal, it will be replaced by an animal from your pile.
<bold>If all the animals in the recruitment line are from your season, you win the game.</bold>
animal.shared: This animal is in <bold>the common help line</bold>. Both players can use its elements.
animal.you: This animal is in <bold>your personal line</bold>. Its elements are <bold>available only to you</bold>.
animal.player: This animal is in <bold>{player}'s personal line</bold>. Its elements are <bold>available only to him or her</bold>.
varan.count: Each player has 7 Fire Varan cards of his color. There {deck, plural, one{is # Varan} other{are # Varans}} of that color left in the deck, so there {count, plural, one{is #} other{are #}} in play.
varan.personal: The Varan is always placed in the player's personal line, therefore giving a solitary symbol only to that player.
varan.receive: The Varans can come into play at the end of the turn, when Winter and Summer both played or lost their 2 Action tokens :
action.token.rule:
Each player has 2 Action tokens.
During their turn, players can use 1 action token on 1 guardian animal card in the shared help line.
Once you run out of action tokens, you can no longer play and your turn ends. Your opponent may continue playing until they also run out of action tokens.
You lose an Action token when a third or a fourth solitary symbol is revealed for you.
tree.starting.rule: When players plant trees in their forest, all trees must always be connected to the starting lake by the rivers.
tree.element: Adds 1 <element/> permanently if you plant it in your forest.
tree.rule:
The <bold>Plant Trees</bold> action lets you plant up to 4 trees in your forest (the one at the top of each stack).
Trees in your forest must always be connected to the lake of your starting tree.
If you plant side by side 2 trees which offer the same bonus action, you immediately perform the corresponding bonus action.
tree.win: If your forest contains 9 trees in a 3x3-card grid, you immediately win the game.
discard.count: There are {number, plural, one{# card} other{# cards}} in the common discard pile. When the draw pile is empty, the common discard pile is shuffled to make a new draw pile.
tuto.welcome: Welcome to the <bold>Living Forest Duel</bold> tutorial!
tuto.seasons: In this game, <bold>Summer</bold> and <bold>Winter</bold> face off to protect the forest from the terrible flames of <bold>Onibi</bold>.
tuto.turn: You play as Summer. On your turn, you must either <bold>draw a card</bold> or play one of your <bold>2 Action tokens</bold>.
tuto.animals: Here is the pile of <bold>Guardian Animal cards</bold>. It is <bold>common to both players</bold>. Draw a card.
tuto.line.common: You have drawn this Guardian Animal. It goes into the <bold>common help line</bold> for both players.
tuto.draw: Your opponent has drawn this Animal, which is placed <bold>afterwards</bold> in the common help line.
tuto.tokens: It's your turn. Here are your 2 <bold>Action tokens</bold>.
tuto.action: To use an Action token, you must place it <bold>pointing to the last element of the common help line</bold> corresponding to the action you want to perform: <sun/>, <water/>, <plant/>, <wind/>.
tuto.sun:
Play the <sun/> action. You will gain the 4 <sun/> visible in the common help line.
These 4 <sun/> <bold>will no longer be available</bold>.
tuto.action.recruit:
The <sun/> action allows you to <bold>recruit animals</bold>.
Here are the 7 animals you can recruit.
tuto.animal.cost: The cost of an animal is shown at the bottom right of the card.
tuto.animal.season: You have recruited an animal <bold>from your season</bold> (Summer). The season of an animal is shown at the bottom left of the card.
tuto.neutral: All animals in the starting pile, as well as the Stag, are neutral.
tuto.line.mine: When you recruit an animal from your season, it goes <bold>into your personal line</bold>. Only you benefit from the elements provided by the animals in your personal line!
tuto.recruit.ram:
You can also recruit animals that are not from your season: in this case, <bold>they go into the common discard pile</bold>, and your opponent will not be able to benefit from them immediately.
Recruit this animal from Winter.
tuto.action.pass: Click on <bold>pass</bold> in the header to finish your action.
tuto.replace: The recruited cards are replaced by cards <bold>from your personal pile</bold>.
tuto.sun.win:
If the recruitment line contains <bold>only</bold> animals from your season, you fulfill the victory condition associated with <sun/> and <bold>win immediately</bold>.
<italic>The Stag is a neutral animal and must also be recruited.</italic>
tuto.solitary:
Your opponent drew this animal. It has a <bold>Solitary symbol</bold>: <solitary/>.
If you have 3 Solitary symbols, <bold>you lose an Action token</bold> for this turn.
On the 4th Solitary symbol, you lose <bold>your second Action token</bold>.
<italic>The Solitary symbols in the common help line count for both players, but those in your personal line only count for you.</italic>
tuto.draw.you: It's your turn. Draw a card.
tuto.solitary.2:
It's another Solitary animal <solitary/>. One more and you and your opponent will each lose an Action token!
<italic>There are 6 Solitary animals in the starting pile.</bold>
tuto.extinguish: Your opponent played an Action token to perform the <bold>extinguish fire</bold> action with 4 <water/>.
tuto.fire: The <bold>extinguish fire</bold> action allows you to recover <bold>the Fire tokens</bold> that are here, in the Sacred Clearing.
tuto.fire.cost: The cost of each Fire token depends on the Clearing card it is on. Here, Winter will be able to extinguish the 2 fires with its 4 <water/>.
tuto.water.win: If a player has <bold>8 Fire tokens</bold> or more, they fulfill the victory condition associated with <water/> and <bold>win immediately</bold>!
tuto.action.plant: Your turn. Use your second Action token to <bold>plant Trees</bold>: <plant/>.
tuto.trees: Here are the <bold>Tree cards</bold>. With the <bold>plant Trees</bold> action, you can plant up to 4 trees (one from each stack).
tuto.tree.cost: The cost of a Tree is indicated at the bottom left of the card.
tuto.tree.start:
Here is your <bold>starting protective Tree</bold>.
All the trees you plant must always be <bold>connected by a river</bold> to your starting tree.
tuto.plant:
Use your 2 <plant/> to plant this tree in your forest.
<italic>Drag and drop the card on one of the valid spots around your starting tree.</bold>
tuto.tree.element:
The tree you just planted gives you 1 <sun/> for your <bold>recruit animal</bold> actions for the rest of the game!
<italic>You can plant a tree over an existing tree. In that case, you lose the benefit of the first tree.</bold>
tuto.tree.bonus:
The half <water/> symbol visible on the edges of the card corresponds to a <bold>bonus action</bold>.
When you plant a tree next to it, their bonus actions can be different. However, if they are identical and you complete the symbol, you <bold>immediately perform the corresponding bonus action</bold>.
The bonus action is performed with <bold>the available elements</bold> at the time it is carried out: never count the elements already pointed to by an Action token in the common help line.
tuto.plant.win: If your Forest contains <bold>9 Trees placed in a 3x3 grid</bold> of cards, you fulfill the victory condition associated with <plant/> and <bold>win immediately</bold>.
tuto.turn.over: You have played <bold>your 2 Action tokens</bold>. You will not play again until the end of the turn, when your opponent has also played - or lost - their 2 Action tokens.
tuto.solitary.3: Your opponent can draw cards. However, if they reveal <bold>a third solitary symbol</bold> <solitary/>, they will lose an Action token and the turn will end.
tuto.action.wind: Your opponent has played the action <bold>advance Onibi</bold> <wind/>. They have 3 <wind/> available.
tuto.onibi: The action <bold>advance Onibi</bold> allows you to move <bold>the Onibi pawn</bold> towards your opponent in the Clearing, up to a maximum number of steps equal to the <wind/> available.
tuto.wind.bonus: After moving Onibi, the player immediately performs the <bold>bonus action</bold> indicated on the rock of the arrival card.
tuto.bonus.sanki:
This bonus action consists of taking a <bold>Sanki card</bold>.
There are only 3 Sanki cards. If there are none left in the supply, they are taken from the opponent!
We will explain right after what the Sanki cards are for.
tuto.onibi.card:
If a player takes Onibi out of the Clearing, it continues its path to the other side, and the opponent receives <bold>the Onibi card</bold>.
The Onibi card is a penalty! When a player has this card, the animals of their season do not go into their personal line, they go <bold>into the common help line</bold>.
tuto.wind.win: If the same player takes Onibi out of the Clearing again, <bold>they win the game</bold>! It’s the victory condition associated with the <wind/> element.
tuto.varan: It is now the end of the turn. Here are the <bold>Fire Varan cards</bold>.
tuto.fire.value:
At the end of the turn, we calculate the fire power by adding the values of all the clearing cards on fire.
A card is on fire if there is <bold>a fire token</bold> or <bold>the Onibi pawn</bold> on it: in this turn, the fire power is 4.
tuto.water.value:
Each player then checks their value in <water/>. The number of <water/> in the personal line, the forest, and the remaining available in the common help line is counted.
Here, you have 2 <water/> (thanks to your personal line), and your opponent has 0 <water/>.
tuto.varan.get:
If the fire power exceeds a player's value in <water/>, <bold>they receive a Fire Varan for each clearing card on fire</bold>.
Each player places one of their Fire Varans in the common discard pile.
tuto.varan.detail: Fire Varans are penalties: they only give a solitary symbol <solitary/>, and <bold>always go into the personal line</bold> of the player they belong to.
tuto.sanki.varan: Fortunately, <bold>Sanki cards</bold> allow you to eliminate them! When one of your Varans is revealed, you can return it to its pile by discarding a Sanki card.
tuto.sanki.replay: Sanki cards can also be used to <bold>play an Action token immediately</bold> after revealing a Guardian Animal, without passing the turn to the other player.
tuto.fire.put: At the end of the turn, the 2 clearing cards around Onibi each receive a fire token if there wasn’t one.
tuto.turn.new: Then, the Guardian Animals are discarded, players recover their Action tokens, and a new turn begins.
tuto.win.conditions:
For the record, there are 4 ways to win:
<sun/> : have 7 animals of your season on the recruitment line.
<water/> : have 8 Fire tokens.
<plant/> plant a forest containing 9 trees in a 3x3 grid of cards.
<wind/> bring Onibi to the opponent when they already have the Onibi card.
tuto.remind:
You can click on any element at any time to get a reminder of the associated rules.
Now it’s your turn to play, good luck!
